units_policy: All numerical records specify frame, proper/comoving convention, clock origin and normalization; use explicit c,k_B and locked sigma_T.

columns.name: a
columns.semantics: mean scale factor in locked normalization

columns.name: J0_photon_u_eV_per_H
columns.semantics: U_0=(1/nH_proper)*integral E*J_0(E,t) dE; solid-angle-integrated Legendre energy moment per H, not angular mean

columns.name: J1_photon_u_eV_per_H
columns.semantics: U_1=(1/nH_proper)*integral E*J_1(E,t) dE; solid-angle-integrated Legendre energy moment per H, not angular mean

columns.name: J2_photon_u_eV_per_H
columns.semantics: U_2=(1/nH_proper)*integral E*J_2(E,t) dE; solid-angle-integrated Legendre energy moment per H, not angular mean

columns.name: x_HeI

Record both candidate/reference coordinates and interpolate only along the declared comparison coordinate within supported overlap; keep Tgas branches time ordered.

columns.name: normalization_registry
columns.semantics: registry ID binding complete selected-model baryon inventory and any omitted reservoir, element denominators, electron census and clock semantics

abundances.csv.neutral_states: H I=nH*(1-xHII), He I=nHe*(1-xHeII-xHeIII); reject invalid sums/negativity, never clip states
abundances.csv.baryon_conservation: n_b is the complete baryon inventory of the selected model, including any explicitly declared omitted reservoir; H/He-only baseline n_b=n_H+4*n_He. Electrons are excluded. The tracked sum is the full denominator only when the tracked nuclear registry is complete. Require nonnegative densities/charge fractions and per-element charge fractions summing to 1. Sum over all model nuclear species A_i*Y_i=1 within the locked tolerance. If a declared baryon reservoir is omitted from the tracked species, tracked sum A_i*Y_i may be <1 and its missing fraction must be explicitly recorded. Check electron charge census separately; never clip invalid states.
abundances.csv.range_semantics: 0<=element charge fractions<=1 and per-element sum=1; Y uses complete selected-model n_b, not a partial tracked sum. Tracked sum A_iY_i may be below 1 with a declared omitted reservoir; electrons follow separate charge census.
abundances.csv.inventory_semantics: Fixed BBN/donor elemental totals are inputs; reionization charge fractions evolve. Unimplemented D/T/He3/Li extensions are explicitly missing optional, no full 17-network claim.
abundances.csv.coverage: actual complete selected supported time-ordered histories; full registry including any additional actually evolved species

angular_moment_convention.spectral_definition: J_l(E,t)=2*pi*integral_{-1}^{1} P_l(mu)*n_gamma(E,mu,t) dmu; n_gamma is proper photon number per volume, energy and solid angle. J_l is a solid-angle integral, not an angular average or specific intensity.
angular_moment_convention.per_H_energy_moment: U_l(t)=(1/nH_proper)*integral E*J_l(E,t) dE. With E in eV and consistent volume units U_l is eV/H.
angular_moment_convention.discrete_rule: For energy-angle cell-integrated photon energy/H, U_l=sum_cells P_l(mu)*cell_energy_per_H; quadrature weights apply only to densities not already integrated. Never apply 2*pi/4*pi or cell weights twice.
angular_moment_convention.J1: U_1 and spectral J_1 vanish within locked tolerance only under reflection-even IC/emissivity and symmetric microphysics; axisymmetry alone is insufficient.
angular_moment_convention.J2: Quadrupole retained in RT. Pressure anisotropy is integral E*J_2 dE=nH_proper*U_2 with consistent units; geometric feedback is omitted only within quantified approximation scope.

raw_and_checkpoint_contract.raw: Preserve actual stdout/stderr/config/run records under case/raw; do not fabricate historical absent streams
raw_and_checkpoint_contract.checkpoint: Bind current driver/source/config and solved state, completed interval and resume command; missing future checkpoint is not present evidence
raw_and_checkpoint_contract.immutable_history: Do not rewrite old receipts or retained frozen outputs

admission.science: Applicable main abundance-goal criteria plus independent AX15 scoped decision; scientifically accepted conditional full-history scope allowed. Tau/tail/full CMB nonblocking secondary.
admission.empirical_vs_rigorous: Explicitly distinguish convergence estimates from rigorous interval/continuum proof; old theorem work is not a blanket prerequisite
admission.allowed_null_result: Quantitatively resolved null or valid upper bound within declared supported family
admission.goal_not_complete: NOT_RUN/blocked-only manuscript, planning publication or no-ready-nodes state

flagship: complete nuclear/ion abundance histories and BBN-style plots

required_species.state: charge-census ne; excluded from baryon inventory; nuclear Z not applicable

normalization_registry.additional_actually_evolved_species: Every additional evolved nuclide/charge state must be listed with A,Z,charge,element, provenance, state semantics and normalization; never omit it from outputs silently.

element_fraction.electron: not an element charge fraction; null element_fraction, report ye or xe separately

normalization_registry.baryon_inventory: n_b is the complete baryon inventory of the selected model, including any explicitly declared omitted reservoir; H/He-only baseline n_b=n_H+4*n_He. Electrons are excluded. The tracked sum is the full denominator only when the tracked nuclear registry is complete.
normalization_registry.BBN_number_abundance: Y_i=n_i/n_b; per baryon in the complete selected-model inventory, distinct from element charge fraction. Do not renormalize to a partial tracked registry.

electron_normalizations.must_label: always name denominator; electrons excluded from nb sum

normalization_registry.optional_mass_fraction: X_i=A_i*Y_i, separately labelled baryon mass fraction; never mix with number/charge fractions
normalization_registry.fixed_nuclear_vs_ionic: Donor BBN total elemental/nuclear abundances are fixed input inventory (proper densities expand); reionization evolves charge-state fractions. Do not claim nuclear reaction/BBN synthesis from ionic evolution.
normalization_registry.conservation: Require nonnegative densities/charge fractions and per-element charge fractions summing to 1. Sum over all model nuclear species A_i*Y_i=1 within the locked tolerance. If a declared baryon reservoir is omitted from the tracked species, tracked sum A_i*Y_i may be <1 and its missing fraction must be explicitly recorded. Check electron charge census separately; never clip invalid states.

omitted_baryon_reservoir.binding: Explicitly record whether selected-model inventory is exactly H/He baseline, all tracked nuclear species, or includes a quantified omitted reservoir. A tracked sum below 1 is legitimate only with that declared inventory.

mandatory_plot_contract.time_axis: proper cosmic seconds with bound origin; if only elapsed time available label elapsed correctly
mandatory_plot_contract.gas_temperature: Tgas may reheat/be nonmonotonic; plot parametric time-ordered trajectories with arrows/branch labels. Never sort by T to fabricate a single-valued Y(T).
mandatory_plot_contract.optional_background_reference: Tref=T0/a with selected model T0, distinctly labelled reference; not exact direction-dependent CMB temperature in Bianchi I.
mandatory_plot_contract.logarithmic_abundance_axis: Use where appropriate; exact zeros masked/annotated in display, never clip state or add a fabricated floor.

donor_four_velocity_map.required_donor_binding: Record whether donor uses unit normal or physical four-velocity, coordinate/time units and the explicit conversion; do not silently interchange them.
